# Tool arguments

**Generated by `scripts/gen_tool_reference.py`; do not edit by hand.** Every tool an MCP client can
list, with its arguments, taken from the code. Use it to look up a name, a default or what is
required. For behavior, refusals and limits, read the page linked in each section.

Arguments are shown as `name` (type, required) or `name` (type, default). Generic scene tools refuse
arguments they do not declare, so a misspelled name is an error rather than being ignored. A live
bridge's own metadata takes precedence over these snapshots once discovered.

## Host gateway and desktop

Reference: [TOOLS-HOST.md](TOOLS-HOST.md). 12 tools.

### `join_videos`

Join 2-8 finished video clips into one new MP4 with the bundled ffmpeg, in order or stacked. Never overwrites. For a synced side-by-side demo prefer start_screen_recording(window_ids=...). Audio is dropped; encoding is bounded to 15 minutes and the result to 1 hour.

- `inputs` (list[str], required): 2-8 absolute paths under home, or file names in ~/Videos/screen-mcp.
- `mode` (str, default `'concat'`): concat (one after another), hstack (side by side) or vstack (top to bottom).
- `output` (str | None, default `None`): New file name in ~/Videos/screen-mcp, or an absolute .mp4 path under home. Default joined-<time>.mp4.
- `max_width` (int, default `1920`): Output width cap in pixels.
- `fps` (int | None, default `None`): Output rate, at most 60. Default: the fastest input.
- `shortest` (bool, default `False`): hstack/vstack: end with the shortest clip instead of freezing it on its last frame.

### `list_windows`

List visible top-level windows with id, title, class, PID and size. Use it first to get the window_id other window tools need.

- `filter` (str | None, default `None`): Keep windows whose title or WM class contains this.

### `move_window`

Move and resize one window, e.g. to place Isaac Sim and RViz before a recording. Get its id from list_windows; for several windows use tile_windows. Un-maximizes it first, and returns the geometry applied and whether the window manager clamped it.

- `x` (int, required): Left edge in pixels, from the screen's top-left.
- `y` (int, required): Top edge in pixels, from the screen's top-left.
- `width` (int, required): Width in pixels.
- `height` (int, required): Height in pixels.
- `window` (str | None, default `None`): Window title or WM class substring, from list_windows.
- `window_id` (int | None, default `None`): Window id from list_windows.
- `expected_pid` (int | None, default `None`): Refuse unless the window belongs to this PID, from list_windows.
- `frame` (bool, default `False`): true: place the outer frame with its title bar. Default: the client area that captures record.

### `raise_window`

Activate a window and give it focus. Get its id from list_windows first.

- `window` (str | None, default `None`): Window title or WM class substring, from list_windows.
- `window_id` (int | None, default `None`): Window id from list_windows.
- `expected_pid` (int | None, default `None`): Refuse unless the window belongs to this PID, from list_windows.

### `refresh_tools`

Re-discover the bridge's tools and register new ones. Use after Kit starts or restarts, after reload_tools, or when tools seem missing.

- `wait_s` (float, default `0`): Seconds to keep polling while no bridge answers, 0-180. A first Kit start can take 120-180.

### `screen_info`

Report the X11 display, monitors, capture directories and recording state.

No arguments.

### `screen_recording_status`

Show whether a desktop recording is running and for how long.

No arguments.

### `screenshot`

Capture the screen, a monitor or a window to see the result of your work. Returns the image and its PNG path. With no arguments it captures the Isaac Sim window if one is open, otherwise the primary monitor. A window capture works even when another window covers it.

- `monitor` (int | None, default `None`): 1-based monitor index from screen_info; 0 means all monitors combined.
- `window` (str | None, default `None`): Window title or WM class substring, from list_windows.
- `window_id` (int | None, default `None`): Window id from list_windows.
- `max_width` (int, default `1600`): Inline image width cap in pixels, 320-3840. The saved PNG stays full size.

### `start_screen_recording`

Start a desktop MP4 recording, e.g. for a demo; one at a time, no audio. Stop it with stop_screen_recording, which gives the path. With no arguments it records the Isaac Sim window if one is open. A window recording reads that window's own pixels, so it works when covered or on a locked screen. Details: docs/TOOLS-HOST.md. For a clean viewport render of the UR5e twin, use ur5e_dt__start_recording; to combine clips, join_videos.

- `monitor` (int | None, default `None`): 1-based monitor index from screen_info; 0 means all monitors combined.
- `window` (str | None, default `None`): Window title or WM class substring, from list_windows.
- `window_id` (int | None, default `None`): Window id from list_windows.
- `fps` (int, default `15`): Frames per second, clamped to 1-30. Frames repeat if capture falls behind.
- `max_width` (int | None, default `None`): Output width cap in pixels; never scales up. Default 1920.
- `max_seconds` (int, default `600`): Stops by itself after this long, clamped to 5-3600 seconds.
- `full_screen` (bool | None, default `None`): true: letterbox into the primary monitor's shape. Default: the native capture size.
- `window_ids` (list[int] | None, default `None`): 2-6 window ids from list_windows, recorded in sync into one video.
- `layout` (str, default `'side_by_side'`): With window_ids: side_by_side, top_bottom or grid.
- `wait_for_window` (float, default `0`): With window: seconds (max 600) to wait for a match. Returns at once, so launch the app next.
- `stop_on_log_marker` (str | None, default `None`): End when this text is added to the selected bridge's Kit log or stop_log_file.
- `stop_log_file` (str | None, default `None`): A .log file in Kit's log folder or under ~/.local/share/isaac-mcp, for stop_on_log_marker.

### `stop_screen_recording`

Stop the active desktop recording and report the MP4 path, duration and size.

No arguments.

### `tile_windows`

Tile 2-6 windows over a monitor's work area, e.g. Isaac Sim left and RViz 2 right for a demo. Get ids from list_windows. Reports each window's final geometry and whether the window manager clamped it; then record them with start_screen_recording(window_ids=...).

- `window_ids` (list[int], required): 2-6 window ids from list_windows.
- `layout` (str, default `'left_right'`): left_right (one row), top_bottom (one column) or grid.
- `monitor` (int | None, default `None`): 1-based index from screen_info. Default: the monitor holding the first window.
- `gap` (int, default `0`): Pixels between tiles.

### `use_bridge`

Switch this MCP server to another running Kit bridge on this machine.

- `port` (int, required): Bridge TCP port from --list-bridges or list_bridges.

## Desktop input (opt-in: `screen_input`)

Reference: [TOOLS-HOST.md](TOOLS-HOST.md#optional-desktop-input). 5 tools.

### `window_click`

Click a visible point in one selected X11 window. Coordinates are original window pixels.

- `window_id` (int, required): Window id from list_windows.
- `expected_pid` (int, required): The window's PID from list_windows; a different owner is refused.
- `x` (int, required): X in original window pixels, from a fresh screenshot.
- `y` (int, required): Y in original window pixels, from a fresh screenshot.
- `expected_width` (int, required): The window width you inspected, in pixels; a changed size is refused.
- `expected_height` (int, required): The window height you inspected, in pixels; a changed size is refused.
- `button` (str, default `'left'`): left, middle or right.
- `clicks` (int, default `1`): 1 or 2.

### `window_drag`

Drag with the left mouse button between two points in the same X11 window.

- `window_id` (int, required): Window id from list_windows.
- `expected_pid` (int, required): The window's PID from list_windows; a different owner is refused.
- `x` (int, required): X in original window pixels, from a fresh screenshot.
- `y` (int, required): Y in original window pixels, from a fresh screenshot.
- `end_x` (int, required): Drag end X in original window pixels.
- `end_y` (int, required): Drag end Y in original window pixels.
- `expected_width` (int, required): The window width you inspected, in pixels; a changed size is refused.
- `expected_height` (int, required): The window height you inspected, in pixels; a changed size is refused.

### `window_key`

Send one navigation/editing key or ASCII letter/digit to the focused X11 window.

- `window_id` (int, required): Window id from list_windows.
- `expected_pid` (int, required): The window's PID from list_windows; a different owner is refused.
- `key` (str, required): A navigation or editing key name, or an ASCII letter or digit, e.g. enter, tab, a.
- `modifiers` (list[str] | None, default `None`): Any of ctrl, shift, alt, super.

### `window_scroll`

Scroll up, down, left or right at a visible window point, at most ten steps per call.

- `window_id` (int, required): Window id from list_windows.
- `expected_pid` (int, required): The window's PID from list_windows; a different owner is refused.
- `x` (int, required): X in original window pixels, from a fresh screenshot.
- `y` (int, required): Y in original window pixels, from a fresh screenshot.
- `expected_width` (int, required): The window width you inspected, in pixels; a changed size is refused.
- `expected_height` (int, required): The window height you inspected, in pixels; a changed size is refused.
- `direction` (str, required): up, down, left or right.
- `steps` (int, default `1`): Scroll steps, 1-10.

### `window_type`

Type up to 200 printable ASCII characters into the focused selected X11 window.

- `window_id` (int, required): Window id from list_windows.
- `expected_pid` (int, required): The window's PID from list_windows; a different owner is refused.
- `text` (str, required): Up to 200 printable ASCII characters.

## Simulator sessions (opt-in: `sim_launch`)

Reference: [TOOLS-HOST.md](TOOLS-HOST.md#optional-simulator-sessions). 4 tools.

### `sim__launch`

Launch a separate managed Isaac Sim instance on its own port and ROS domain, when explicitly asked.

- `port` (int, required): A free local TCP port for its bridge, e.g. 18766.
- `ros_domain` (int, required): ROS_DOMAIN_ID 0-231, distinct from other sessions.
- `headless` (bool, default `False`): true: no window.
- `allow_shared_domain` (bool, default `False`): true: allow a ROS domain another session already uses.
- `show_ur5e_panel` (bool, default `False`): true: show the UR5e twin's panel in a graphical session.
- `enable_motion_bvh` (bool, default `False`): true: accurate RTX LiDAR motion compensation; costs rendering time and GPU memory.
- `physics_backend` (Literal['physx', 'newton'], default `'physx'`): Engine for this new process. Missing Newton dependencies fail with no fallback.

### `sim__list`

List simulators: managed sessions (managed=true), including those started before this server restarted, and advertised bridges started some other way (managed=false; PID, port, app, version).

- `include_exited` (bool, default `False`): List every exited session, not only the most recent few.

### `sim__status`

Report a simulator's process and Kit readiness, by an id from sim__list.

- `session_id` (str, required): id from sim__list or sim__launch.

### `sim__stop`

Stop only the identified managed process; unsaved changes can be lost. Refuses external bridges.

- `session_id` (str, required): id from sim__list or sim__launch.
- `expected_pid` (int, required): PID from sim__status; a different process is refused.
- `confirm_discard` (bool, default `False`): true: accept losing unsaved changes.
- `force` (bool, default `False`): true: SIGKILL its process group; only if normal shutdown failed.

## Isaac Lab

Reference: [TOOLS-ISAACLAB.md](TOOLS-ISAACLAB.md). 12 tools.

### `isaaclab__checkpoints_list`

List policy checkpoints (*.pt / *.pth, and stable-baselines3's .zip), newest first, under a run dir or the configured logs.

- `run_dir` (str | None, default `None`): Run folder. Default: search the configured logs.
- `task` (str | None, default `None`): Keep runs of this task id.

### `isaaclab__envs_list`

List registered Isaac Lab task ids (optionally filtered by substring).

- `filter` (str | None, default `None`): Keep task ids containing this text.

### `isaaclab__eval`

Run a policy checkpoint (headless by default) as a job and return its job_id.

- `task` (str, required): Task id from isaaclab__envs_list, e.g. Isaac-Cartpole-v0.
- `checkpoint` (str, required): Checkpoint file from isaaclab__checkpoints_list.
- `num_envs` (int | None, default `None`): Parallel environments. Default: the task's own.
- `headless` (bool, default `True`): false opens a window. true with extra_args=['--video'] keeps a renderer with no window.
- `rl_library` (str | None, default `None`): RL library name, e.g. rsl_rl. Default: the Isaac Lab script's own.
- `extra_args` (list[str] | None, default `None`): More command-line arguments for the Isaac Lab script, e.g. ['--video'].
- `timeout_s` (float | None, default `None`): Stop the job after this many seconds. Default: no limit.
- `allow_concurrent` (bool, default `False`): Start even if another job is running; a 16 GB GPU normally fits one.
- `allow_concurrent_gpu` (bool, default `False`): Start even if an Isaac Sim (Kit bridge) app is using the GPU.

### `isaaclab__install_info`

Report the Isaac Lab install: interpreter, versions, root, venv.

No arguments.

### `isaaclab__metrics_summary`

Summarise TensorBoard scalars of a run (last, min, max, step, count per tag).

- `run_dir` (str, required): Run folder, as shown by isaaclab__checkpoints_list or isaaclab__runs_status.
- `tags` (list[str] | None, default `None`): Scalar tags to include. Default: all.

### `isaaclab__play`

Play a checkpoint with a window (interactive); stop it with isaaclab__runs_cancel.

- `task` (str, required): Task id from isaaclab__envs_list, e.g. Isaac-Cartpole-v0.
- `checkpoint` (str, required): Checkpoint file from isaaclab__checkpoints_list.
- `num_envs` (int, default `1`): Parallel environments.
- `headless` (bool, default `False`): false opens a window. true with extra_args=['--video'] keeps a renderer with no window.
- `rl_library` (str | None, default `None`): RL library name, e.g. rsl_rl. Default: the Isaac Lab script's own.
- `extra_args` (list[str] | None, default `None`): More command-line arguments for the Isaac Lab script, e.g. ['--video'].
- `timeout_s` (float | None, default `None`): Stop the job after this many seconds. Default: no limit.
- `allow_concurrent` (bool, default `False`): Start even if another job is running; a 16 GB GPU normally fits one.
- `allow_concurrent_gpu` (bool, default `False`): Start even if an Isaac Sim (Kit bridge) app is using the GPU.

### `isaaclab__runs_cancel`

Stop a job: SIGTERM to its process group, SIGKILL after grace_s seconds.

- `job_id` (str, required): job_id from isaaclab__train, eval or play, or isaaclab__runs_list.
- `grace_s` (int, default `10`): Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL.

### `isaaclab__runs_list`

List Isaac Lab jobs, to find a job_id.

- `state` (str | None, default `None`): running or finished. Default: all.

### `isaaclab__runs_status`

State, exit code, elapsed time, last log lines and newest checkpoint of a job. For a windowed job also `window` (id, title, size): pass its id to screenshot(window_id=...) or start_screen_recording(window_id=...) to see the result. Reconciles orphaned jobs by updating their stored metadata.

- `job_id` (str, required): job_id from isaaclab__train, eval or play, or isaaclab__runs_list.

### `isaaclab__runs_tail`

Last lines of a job's stdout or stderr log. Creates the jobs directory if missing.

- `job_id` (str, required): job_id from isaaclab__train, eval or play, or isaaclab__runs_list.
- `stream` (str, default `'stdout'`): stdout or stderr.
- `lines` (int, default `100`): How many of the last lines to return.

### `isaaclab__tensorboard_tail`

Last points of one TensorBoard scalar (a training curve). Find tags with isaaclab__metrics_summary.

- `run_dir` (str, required): Run folder, as shown by isaaclab__checkpoints_list or isaaclab__runs_status.
- `tag` (str, required): Scalar tag, from isaaclab__metrics_summary.
- `last_n` (int | None, default `50`): How many of the newest points to return.

### `isaaclab__train`

Start a training job and return its job_id immediately; follow it with isaaclab__runs_status/tail.

- `task` (str, required): Task id from isaaclab__envs_list, e.g. Isaac-Cartpole-v0.
- `num_envs` (int, default `64`): Parallel environments.
- `max_iterations` (int | None, default `None`): Training iterations. Default: the task's own.
- `seed` (int | None, default `None`): Random seed.
- `device` (str | None, default `None`): e.g. cuda:0 or cpu. Default: Isaac Lab's choice.
- `headless` (bool, default `True`): false opens a window. true with extra_args=['--video'] keeps a renderer with no window.
- `checkpoint` (str | None, default `None`): Checkpoint file to resume from, from isaaclab__checkpoints_list.
- `rl_library` (str | None, default `None`): RL library name, e.g. rsl_rl. Default: the Isaac Lab script's own.
- `extra_args` (list[str] | None, default `None`): More command-line arguments for the Isaac Lab script, e.g. ['--video'].
- `timeout_s` (float | None, default `None`): Stop the job after this many seconds. Default: no limit.
- `allow_concurrent` (bool, default `False`): Start even if another job is running; a 16 GB GPU normally fits one.
- `allow_concurrent_gpu` (bool, default `False`): Start even if an Isaac Sim (Kit bridge) app is using the GPU.

## Bridge built-ins

Reference: [TOOLS-HOST.md](TOOLS-HOST.md#kit-bridge-built-ins). 7 tools.

### `get_file`

Read a file from the bridge box's disk, returned base64-encoded (content_b64). Pull half of put_file.

- `path` (string, required): Path on the bridge's box (~ expands).

### `list_bridges`

List all isaac.mcp.bridge bridges advertised on this box (this Kit process and any siblings, e.g. a second instance on an ephemeral port).

No arguments.

### `put_file`

Write a file on the bridge's box (content base64-encoded). run_python executes on the box, so code and assets must exist on ITS disk — this verb ships them from a remote driver without a side-channel rsync/scp. Writing a .py purges the sibling __pycache__ so the next import can't serve stale bytecode. Content rides one NDJSON frame in memory: right for code and tool-sized assets, not multi-GB payloads.

- `path` (string, required): Destination path on the bridge's box (~ expands).
- `content_b64` (string, required): File content, base64-encoded.
- `mkdirs` (boolean, optional): Create missing parent directories (default true).

### `reload_tools`

Hot-reload one autoloaded tool package: unregister its owner, re-import the module (the submodule named _state is preserved so live handles survive), and re-register its tools. Follow with the MCP front-end's refresh so new schemas are rediscovered.

- `module` (string, required): Tool-package module name as registered (see list_tools namespaces / owners).

### `run_python`

Execute Python code on the Kit main thread with full access to the Omniverse APIs (omni, carb, pxr preloaded; assign to `result` to return a value). Top-level `await` works (e.g. `await omni.kit.app.get_app().next_update_async()` to let frames run between steps). Set persistent=True with a session_id to keep variables alive between calls — useful for multi-step workflows where later calls need results from earlier ones. Opening a stage (including save-as) resets every session; the next call says so.

- `code` (string, required): Python code to execute on Kit's main thread
- `session_id` (string, optional): Session identifier for persistent execution. Use the same ID across calls to share state. Defaults to 'default'.
- `persistent` (boolean, optional): If true, variables persist across calls with the same session_id.

### `stat_file`

Existence, size, and sha256 of a file on the bridge's box — lets a remote driver skip unchanged pushes and verify assets instead of blindly re-syncing.

- `path` (string, required): Path on the bridge's box (~ expands).

### `status`

Instance identity: pid, port, headless-vs-headful, app + version, uptime, registered namespaces — verify you reached the instance you intended.

No arguments.

## Generic scene (`sim__*`)

Reference: [TOOLS-SCENE.md](TOOLS-SCENE.md). 41 tools.

### `sim__body__state`

Read initialized rigid-body world pose on selected PhysX or qualified Newton backend; fails when stopped/uninitialized or not a body. Position in stage units, quaternion [w,x,y,z]. Optional runtime velocities/mass from tensor API; no authored-USD fallback. PHYSICS_STATE_INVALID identifies invalid observed data, not bad caller input. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, optional): Absolute rigid body path; prim and prim_path are aliases. Supply one.
- `prim` (string, optional): Alias for path.
- `prim_path` (string, optional): Alias for path.
- `include_dynamics` (boolean, default `false`): Include measured world COM linear/angular velocity and runtime mass, including kg conversion.

### `sim__camera__capture`

Capture RTX camera RGB into an owned CPU buffer and a new PNG in configured output root. Default waits up to five seconds for new render completions AND a matching renderer CPU transfer; no stale annotator fallback. Returns dimensions/hash. No implicit Play or atomic physics-frame synchronization. For a camera from an opened file, pass adopt=true. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Camera created by this pack, or an existing Camera with adopt=true.
- `filename` (string, required): New simple basename ending .png.
- `adopt` (boolean, default `false`): If this exact prim is a Camera with no render resources in this session (e.g. from an opened file), create them here. They count toward the eight sensors and are released on stage change; the prim itself is not edited and stays non-owned.
- `wait_for_render` (boolean, default `true`): True: wait up to five seconds for render completions and a new owned CPU transfer. False: reuse the last validated tool acquisition, possibly from before Stop/reset or scene edits; NOT_READY until a true capture seeds it. Ordinary Play never refreshes this cache. PNG I/O still occurs. No implicit physics advance or atomic sensor/physics guarantee.

### `sim__camera__create`

Create a persistent RTX camera on a stopped timeline, e.g. on a robot link: path=/robot/base_footprint/Camera_1, position=[0.1,0,0.2] (local), rotate_xyz=[90,0,-90] (looks along the parent's +X), focal_length=18, clipping_range=[0.01,100]. USD axes: -Z forward, +Y up. Clipping is in metres (default 0.01..1000), converted to stage units. Returns optics, FOV and the local/world pose. Needs rendered frames; width/height capped at 1024. A USD camera has no tick rate; set ROS rates on the camera helper. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): New camera path; its parent prim (e.g. a robot link) must exist.
- `width` (integer, default `640`): Image width 64..1024.
- `height` (integer, default `480`): Image height 64..1024.
- `position` (array, default `[0, 0, 0]`): Three finite coordinates in stage units.
- `orientation` (array, default `[1, 0, 0, 0]`): Unit quaternion [w,x,y,z].
- `frame` (string, default `"local"`): Pose frame: local or world.
- `rotate_xyz` (array, optional): Orientation as USD rotateXYZ Euler angles in degrees (X, then Y, then Z), instead of the orientation quaternion. With frame=local it is authored as translate + rotateXYZ ops.
- `focal_length` (number, optional): Focal length in mm (0.1..1000); default USD 50.
- `horizontal_aperture` (number, optional): Horizontal aperture in mm (0.1..1000); default USD 20.955. The vertical aperture follows width/height.
- `clipping_range` (array, default `[0.01, 1000.0]`): [near, far] clipping distances in metres.
- `target` (array, optional): Optional world look-at point; requires frame=world and explicit position. Overrides orientation.

### `sim__controller__create`

OPT-IN CODE EXECUTION: create OnPlaybackTick -> ScriptNode controller using inline Python. Requires ISAAC_MCP_ENABLE_SCENE_SCRIPTS=1 in Kit launch; NOT a sandbox. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Unused graph path.
- `code` (string, required): Trusted setup(db)/compute(db) script, <=16384 characters.

### `sim__controller__update`

OPT-IN CODE EXECUTION: replace inline code of this pack's controller and request recompilation while stopped. Same explicit script enable required. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Pack controller path.
- `code` (string, required): Trusted replacement script <=16384 characters.

### `sim__graph__build`

Create a whole OmniGraph (e.g. an Action Graph for ROS 2) in one call: nodes, input values, connections and prim targets. Find node types and ports first with sim__graph__node_types. Checks every port, lists the real ones on a typo, and rolls the graph back on any error. Timeline stopped. Returns it as sim__graph__inspect does. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Graph prim path to create, e.g. /World/ROS_Clock or /turtlebot3_burger/ROS_Drive.
- `nodes` (array, required): [name, node_type] pairs or {name, type} objects; entries or whole list may be JSON strings, e.g. ['["tick", "omni.graph.action.OnPlaybackTick"]']. A flat alternating list is also accepted.
- `values` (object, optional): Input values: {"node.inputs:port": value}, or a JSON string containing that object.
- `connections` (array, optional): [from, to] pairs or {from, to} objects; entries or whole list may be JSON strings. A flat alternating list is also accepted.
- `targets` (object, optional): Prim targets: {"node.inputs:targetPrim": ["/World/robot"]}, or a JSON string containing that object or a target path list.
- `evaluator` (execution|push|dirty_push, default `"execution"`): Graph evaluator: execution (Action Graph, default), push or dirty_push.
- `replace` (boolean, default `false`): Delete an existing graph at path first (it is not restored if the new build fails).

### `sim__graph__inspect`

Read an OmniGraph: every node's type, input values or upstream connections, and output connections. Use to verify a hand-built Action Graph (missing wires, unset targets, ports created at runtime). ROS helpers report ros_render_status and writer_computes, which show a sensor that is not rendering; publisher count is not read here, so check with ros2 topic info. Read-only. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Graph prim path, e.g. /World/ROS_Clock.
- `limit` (integer, default `64`): Maximum nodes returned, 1..128.

### `sim__graph__node_types`

Find OmniGraph node types in the running Isaac Sim by id or UI-name substring (e.g. 'Make Array' -> omni.graph.nodes.ConstructArray, 'PublishClock'), with exact input/output port names, types, defaults and descriptions from the installed .ogn files. Use before building Action Graphs; port names differ between Isaac versions. Only contains is required; a catalog read needs no session_id or stage_id.

- `session_id` (string, optional): Not needed; accepted and ignored.
- `stage_id` (string, optional): Not needed; accepted and ignored.
- `contains` (string, required): Substring of the node type id or its UI name, case-insensitive (<=64 chars).
- `limit` (integer, default `20`): Maximum node types returned, 1..40.
- `ports` (boolean, optional): Include ports (default: only when 5 or fewer types match; at most 8 detailed).

### `sim__graph__show`

Open a graph in the Action Graph editor of a windowed Isaac Sim and zoom to fit, e.g. for a demo video. layout=true arranges nodes and writes positions into the stage, so stop first or use layout=false while playing; TIMELINE_ACTIVE includes a retry_with call. close=true closes the editor. Uses the editor's internal API and refuses cleanly if it changed. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, default `""`): Graph prim path (not needed with close=true).
- `layout` (boolean, default `false`): Expand and auto-arrange nodes that have no stored position yet (writes node positions).
- `width` (integer, default `0`): Undock the editor window and size it (pixels, clamped to the Isaac Sim window); 0 keeps the docked layout.
- `height` (integer, default `0`): Window height in pixels when width is set.
- `close` (boolean, default `false`): Close the Action Graph editor window instead of showing a graph.

### `sim__joints__command`

Command initialized articulation position targets on selected PhysX or qualified Newton backend in DOF order. Radians for revolute, stage units for prismatic; validates runtime limits. Returns target acknowledgment, not achieved pose: a contact can hold the robot short of a target, so compare sim__joints__state, and a fresh scene if unsure. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Exact initialized articulation root path.
- `positions` (array, required): One finite position per DOF, in sim.joints.state order.

### `sim__joints__drive`

Set one revolute/prismatic joint drive target and gains in session layer; stopped timeline only. Angular target radians; gains use USD degrees-based convention. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Revolute or prismatic joint path.
- `target` (number, required): Radians for angular joint, stage units for prismatic.
- `stiffness` (number, required): Nonnegative USD drive stiffness.
- `damping` (number, required): Nonnegative USD drive damping.
- `max_force` (number, default `1000`): Positive force/torque cap.

### `sim__joints__inspect`

Inspect bounded authored joint limits/drives below an articulation, reporting USD degrees versus stage units. No runtime-state claim. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Subtree or articulation root.
- `limit` (integer, default `200`): Visited prim cap 1..200.

### `sim__joints__state`

Read initialized articulation DOF positions/velocities on selected PhysX or qualified Newton tensor API. Angular radians, linear stage units; no authored-target fallback. PHYSICS_STATE_INVALID identifies invalid runtime joint data. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Exact articulation root path.

### `sim__lidar__create`

Create an RTX LiDAR (OmniLidar) while stopped: NVIDIA's named config (e.g. config=Example_Rotary_2D at /robot/base_scan/Lidar2D) or, without config, a local generic LiDAR. Config assets come from Isaac's assets root; an unknown name lists the valid ones. Returns prim type, sensor path and rates. At most eight sensors; delete an exact owned sensor path to release resources. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Unused LiDAR prim path; its parent prim (e.g. a robot link) must exist.
- `position` (array, default `[0, 0, 0]`): Three finite coordinates in stage units.
- `orientation` (array, default `[1, 0, 0, 0]`): Unit quaternion [w,x,y,z].
- `frame` (string, default `"local"`): Pose frame: local or world.
- `rotate_xyz` (array, optional): Orientation as USD rotateXYZ Euler angles in degrees, instead of the orientation quaternion.
- `config` (string, default `""`): NVIDIA lidar config name, e.g. Example_Rotary_2D, Example_Rotary, OS1, RPLIDAR_S2E. Empty: local generic LiDAR.
- `variant` (string, default `""`): Config variant, e.g. OS1_REV6_32ch10hz1024res (an invalid one lists the valid ones).
- `tick_rate` (number, optional): Sensor tick rate in Hz (0..240]; default: the config's scan rate (10 Hz for Example_Rotary_2D). A rate other than the scan rate yields partial scans.

### `sim__lidar__read`

Read CPU Cartesian LiDAR return points in sensor coordinates with sensor-to-world transform, filter invalid ranges, cap at 256 samples. Requires initialized sensor and rendered simulation frames. For a LiDAR from an opened file, pass adopt=true. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Pack-created LiDAR path, or an existing OmniLidar with adopt=true.
- `limit` (integer, default `64`): Maximum returned points 1..256.
- `adopt` (boolean, default `false`): If this exact prim is an OmniLidar with no render resources in this session (e.g. from an opened file), create them here. They count toward the eight sensors and are released on stage change; settings a read needs are overridden in the session layer only and reported as session_overrides. The prim stays non-owned.
- `wait_for_render` (boolean, default `false`): Wait up to five seconds for one render; acquisition requires Play. False reads the latest completed scan, possibly stale. No implicit physics advance or atomic sensor/physics guarantee.

### `sim__light__create`

Create a SphereLight, DistantLight or DomeLight without asset-valued textures. Pose in stage units, orientation wxyz. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): New prim path.
- `kind` (string, default `"DistantLight"`): SphereLight, DistantLight or DomeLight.
- `intensity` (number, default `1000`): Nonnegative USD light intensity.
- `color` (array, default `[1, 1, 1]`): RGB linear color 0..1.
- `position` (array, default `[0, 0, 0]`): Three finite coordinates in stage units.
- `orientation` (array, default `[1, 0, 0, 0]`): Unit quaternion [w,x,y,z].
- `frame` (string, default `"local"`): Pose frame: local or world.

### `sim__light__modify`

Set intensity and color (both required) of a pack-owned light on a stopped timeline. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Pack-owned light path.
- `intensity` (number, required): USD light intensity.
- `color` (array, required): RGB linear color 0..1.

### `sim__logs__tail`

Read bounded tail of selected Kit log, not arbitrary files. Returns warnings/errors and source path, without clearing shared logs, plus scene_events: recent stage opens and timeline changes with their source (a tool, or outside the tools such as a person in the GUI). Use it to explain a STALE_TARGET. Needs no session_id or stage_id.

- `session_id` (string, optional): Not needed; accepted and ignored.
- `stage_id` (string, optional): Not needed; accepted and ignored.
- `limit` (integer, default `50`): Maximum lines 1..100.

### `sim__map__occupancy`

Generate a 2D occupancy map from the stage's colliders (Isaac's occupancy-map generator) and write a Nav2 map_server PGM + YAML (trinary, origin = lower-left corner, +x right, +y up) to the configured output root. Start with the timeline stopped: the tool plays 8 frames through the guarded timeline path (the generator needs running physics; OnPlaybackTick graphs such as /clock run meanwhile), then stops, so robots return to their start poses. Use when a lab or project does not provide map files. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `min` (array, required): World [x, y] lower corner of the map in metres.
- `max` (array, required): World [x, y] upper corner of the map in metres.
- `z` (array, default `[0.05, 0.3]`): World [z_min, z_max] in metres. A collider anywhere in this range marks its cells occupied, so keep z_min above the floor and z_max below anything the robot passes under
- `clear` (array, default `[]`): Up to 16 [x, y, radius] circles (metres) to mark free, e.g. the robot's own footprint at its start pose.
- `start` (array, optional): World [x, y] in free space the generator flood-fills from; cells it cannot reach are unknown. Default: the centre of the bounds (move it if a table or pillar is there).
- `cell_size` (number, default `0.05`): Cell size in metres (map resolution).
- `basename` (string, default `"map"`): Output file stem (letters, digits, _ -); writes <basename>.pgm and .yaml.

Bind a pack-created material to an existing geometry prim in the session layer, preserving source files. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.

### `sim__material__create`

Create a UsdPreviewSurface or physics material with finite numeric parameters. No asset-valued attributes or texture URLs. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): New Material path; parent must exist.

- `roughness` (number, default `0.5`): 0..1.
- `metallic` (number, default `0`): 0..1.
- `kind` (string, default `"pbr"`): pbr or physics.
- `static_friction` (number, default `0.5`): Physics material static friction 0..10.
- `dynamic_friction` (number, default `0.5`): Physics material dynamic friction 0..10.

Set explicitly selected PhysicsScene gravity and time step while stopped. No implicit scene creation or GPU/backend switch. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

### `sim__physics__inspect`

Bounded authored collision/body/mass/joint/articulation report. Does not assert initialized or stable physics. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `root` (string, default `"/"`): Absolute subtree path.

### `sim__prim__clone`

Clone a pack-created simple leaf primitive into a new path, preserving session-layer attributes. Refuses references, children, sensors and articulations. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.

### `sim__prim__create`

Create a Cube, Sphere, Xform, or PhysicsScene in session layer. No arbitrary references/attributes. Stopped timeline, parent and no-conflict required. Dimensions are stage units. Also supports Cylinder, Capsule and Cone; size is diameter/height before optional scale. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): New absolute prim path.
- `kind` (string, required): Cube, Sphere, Cylinder, Capsule, Cone, Xform or PhysicsScene.
- `size` (number, default `1`): Positive cube edge or sphere diameter.
- `rigid` (boolean, default `false`): Author rigid body AND collider on geometry.
- `position` (array, default `[0, 0, 0]`): Three finite coordinates in stage units.
- `orientation` (array, default `[1, 0, 0, 0]`): Unit quaternion [w,x,y,z].
- `frame` (string, default `"local"`): Pose frame: local or world.
- `collision` (boolean, default `false`): Author static collision without rigid-body dynamics.
- `scale` (array, default `[1, 1, 1]`): Positive local XYZ scale, 1e-6..1e4.

### `sim__prim__delete`

Delete one pack-owned subtree from the session layer only. Requires stopped physics and confirm=true; exact owned sensors release their resources; sensor-containing subtrees and articulation roots are refused. Prims from an opened file are not pack-owned, even ones you made earlier: allow_foreign=true deactivates such a prim in the session layer instead (USD cannot remove another layer's opinions from there). It stays composed as inactive and keeps its path; a sim__stage__save copy omits it; source files never change. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Pack-owned root path, or any prim with allow_foreign=true.
- `confirm` (boolean, required): Explicit confirmation; false refuses.
- `allow_foreign` (boolean, default `false`): Also act on a prim these tools did not create in this session: deactivate it in the session layer (or remove it if all its opinions are session-layer ones). World/default prim, articulation and other protections still apply. Source files are unchanged.

### `sim__prim__find`

Bounded literal path substring/type search (not regex). Includes inactive prims. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `contains` (string, default `""`): Literal path substring <=128 characters.
- `type_name` (string, default `""`): Exact USD type or empty.
- `limit` (integer, default `100`): Maximum matches 1..200.

### `sim__prim__get`

Read local/world matrices and authored physics at default USD time. Runtime physics readiness remains unknown. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Absolute prim path.

### `sim__prim__set_transform`

Set a static local/world pose for a prim created by this pack. Refuses playing/paused physics and foreign, animated or complex transform stacks. No claim of runtime teleportation. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Pack-owned prim path.
- `position` (array, default `[0, 0, 0]`): Three finite coordinates in stage units.
- `orientation` (array, default `[1, 0, 0, 0]`): Unit quaternion [w,x,y,z].
- `frame` (string, default `"local"`): Pose frame: local or world.

### `sim__quick_start`

One call that builds a working scene for anyone, with nothing to supply and no IDs: a ground plane, physics scene, lights and a camera aimed at the scene, in the current stage if it is new and empty, otherwise a new one. No real-robot wiring. Edits go to the session layer, and sim__stage__save keeps them. The timeline stays stopped unless play=true. Refuses to drop unsaved edits unless discard_changes=true. Returns the new session_id and stage_id, paths, each asset's source and next steps. For the RISE lab UR5e digital twin, use ur5e_dt__quick_start.

- `robot` (string, optional): Optional robot: a public name (ur5e, from your local copy first, then NVIDIA, honoring strict mode), <pack>/<file.usd> from an asset pack in your asset folder, or an absolute path under an approved root (same rules as assets__import_path). A file found only through a project file's asset_path is refused.
- `ros` (boolean, default `false`): With a robot: also run what sim__ros2__tf_setup runs, and report the shell line that matches this simulator.
- `up_axis` (Z|Y, default `"Z"`): The stage's up axis. The ground, gravity and camera follow it. A robot file must match, or the call refuses with the values to pass.
- `meters_per_unit` (number, default `1.0`): The stage's units, as a positive number (0.01 for centimetres). Ground size, gravity, camera distance and framing scale with it. A robot file must match.
- `play` (boolean, default `false`): Start the timeline after building.
- `discard_changes` (boolean, default `false`): Replace a stage with unsaved edits (they are lost).

### `sim__ros2__tf_setup`

Build one ROS 2 graph for a robot, the same way every time: /clock (sim time), /joint_states, the static world->base_link (or world->odom + odometry for a mobile base) and the robot's link TF from Isaac. Rebuilds its own graph on each call, so no frame is ever published twice by this tool; reuses an existing /clock and reports other ROS 2 publishers in the scene. Timeline must be stopped; publishes while playing. Then use scripts/ros2_rviz_config.py and scripts/ros2_tf_doctor.py (docs/ROS2-RVIZ.md). Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `robot` (string, required): Robot prim at or above its articulation root.
- `base_link` (string, default `""`): Robot root link prim; default: a link named base_link, base_footprint or base.
- `base_frame` (string, default `""`): TF name for the base link; default: the base_link prim name.
- `base` (string, default `"fixed"`): fixed (arm on a table: static world->base) or mobile (odometry: world->odom->base).
- `world_frame` (string, default `"world"`): Root frame for RViz's Fixed Frame, e.g. world or map. Empty: publish no world link (a localization node provides map->odom).
- `link_frames` (string, default `"isaac"`): isaac: Isaac publishes every link frame. robot_state_publisher: Isaac publishes only /joint_states and the base link; run robot_state_publisher with the URDF. Never both.
- `extra_frames` (array, default `[]`): Up to 16 more prims (cameras, LiDARs, tool0) to publish relative to the base link; frame name = prim name.
- `attach_to` (string, default `""`): For a robot that is its own articulation mounted on another (RG2 on a UR5e wrist): the parent link's prim. Publishes parent->base_link dynamically on every tick instead of a static world link, so it follows the arm. Call this tool once per articulation, with a namespace for this one.
- `namespace` (string, default `""`): ROS node namespace prepended to the topics.
- `joint_states_topic` (string, default `"joint_states"`): Joint state topic.
- `clock` (auto|publish|skip, default `"auto"`): auto: reuse an existing /clock, else publish one shared clock for all robots (two clocks make RViz reset constantly); publish: always keep the tool's clock; skip: never create one.

### `sim__simulation__step`

Advance 1..120 exact steps on the selected PhysX or qualified Newton backend while PAUSED and initialized. No app-update pumping or engine fallback. Return measured time delta, runtime rigid-body poses and articulation DOFs; Newton publishes poses to Fabric. Failure after stepping starts reports observed clock/phase in step details; elapsed time does not prove valid physics. No automatic retry or rollback. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `steps` (integer, required): Number of physics steps 1..120.
- `observe_prims` (array, default `[]`): Up to 16 rigid body paths.
- `observe_joints` (array, default `[]`): Up to 8 articulation paths.

### `sim__stage__clear_owned`

Remove only pack-created non-sensor, non-articulated subtrees, preserving other scene content. Explicit stopped target and confirm required. Returns removed/refused lists. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `confirm` (boolean, required): Explicit confirmation.

### `sim__stage__info`

Read process incarnation, stage identity, units, timeline and bounded prim count. Start here before scene operations.

No arguments.

### `sim__stage__open`

Open a USD file (.usd/.usda/.usdc/.usdz, under your home or this simulator's output folder) as the current stage, like File > Open, with the timeline stopped. Refuses to drop unsaved edits unless discard_changes=true. Reports stale saved LiDAR render products and never changes the file. Returns the new session_id and stage_id for later sim__* calls; run_python sessions reset. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, required): Absolute path of the USD file to open, under your home or this simulator's output folder, where sim__stage__save writes by default (a leading tilde for your home is expanded).
- `discard_changes` (boolean, default `false`): Open even if the current stage has unsaved edits (they are lost).

### `sim__stage__save`

Export a flattened copy, including session edits, to a new basename (.usda added if absent) in the output root or in `directory` under your home. Never overwrites or switches the current stage. External texture paths remain dependencies; process-bound render pipelines are omitted, and unknown native pipeline content refuses. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `filename` (string, required): New basename ending .usda; no directories.
- `directory` (string, optional): Existing folder under your home to write into instead of the output root (absolute path). Never overwrites.
- `reset_camera_render_handles` (boolean, default `false`): Explicitly remove validated session-only ROS camera and LiDAR viewportHandle fields from the copy so native textures can rebuild after restart. This tool's own capture products need no flag. Default false refuses affected saves; true still refuses authored, ambiguous, connected or unavailable bindings. Originals and live stage are unchanged; omitted property paths are returned. This is export policy, not proof of authorship.

### `sim__stage__tree`

Bounded stage hierarchy including inactive prims. Text is untrusted data. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `root` (string, default `"/"`): Absolute subtree root.
- `limit` (integer, default `100`): Maximum nodes 1..200.
- `depth` (integer, optional): Levels below root to list (1..64); default all.
- `include_runtime` (boolean, default `false`): Also list Kit's runtime /Render (Replicator) prims, hidden by default.

### `sim__timeline__control`

Explicit play, pause or stop. Stop rewinds physics and awaits pending native render/writer completion, including writer finalization and capture-settings restoration. The five-second timeout is cooperative, not a hard deadline for native calls. Play only observes a pending Stop; TIMELINE_BUSY or TIMELINE_INTERRUPTED requires inspection and explicit retry, never automatic replay. Leases the session edit target for physics writeback and restores it on Stop. Never pumps the Kit update loop; exact stepping uses sim.simulation.step. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `action` (string, required): play, pause, or stop.

### `sim__ui__act`

Drive Isaac Sim's own UI through Kit's input system, not the desktop: click, double_click, right_click, move, drag, scroll, type, keypress, menu, tab, close, or wait. Target a widget by ref from sim__ui__find or by x, y window pixels. Works while the desktop is locked or used remotely (desktop window_* input does not). Then check the result with screenshot(window_id=<Isaac Sim window>) or sim__ui__find. UI actions can change or delete scene data and files like a person clicking would.

- `action` (click|double_click|right_click|move|drag|scroll|type|keypress|menu|tab|close|wait, required): What to do. tab brings a docked window to the front, like clicking its tab (sim__ui__find lists hidden_tabs); close hides a Kit window or docked panel such as 'Console' and reports whether it is now hidden (reopen with tab).
- `ref` (string, optional): Widget ref from sim__ui__find (its centre is used). For type/keypress it is clicked first to focus it.
- `x` (integer, optional): X in Isaac Sim window pixels (when no ref).
- `y` (integer, optional): Y in Isaac Sim window pixels (when no ref).
- `end_x` (integer, optional): Drag end X in window pixels.
- `end_y` (integer, optional): Drag end Y in window pixels.
- `text` (string, optional): Text for action=type (1..500 characters, no newlines; send enter with keypress).
- `keys` (array, optional): For action=keypress: one key plus optional modifiers, e.g. ["ctrl", "s"], ["enter"], ["shift", "tab"].
- `window` (string, optional): For action=tab or close: the window or tab title, e.g. 'Console' or 'Content'.
- `menu` (string, optional): For action=menu: a menu path, e.g. 'Create/Mesh/Cube' (a menu an extension adds exists only once it has loaded), or a top-level menu such as 'Layouts' (opened to list its items, then closed again).
- `scroll_x` (integer, default `0`): Horizontal wheel steps for action=scroll (-20..20).
- `scroll_y` (integer, default `0`): Vertical wheel steps for action=scroll (-20..20; negative scrolls down).
- `frames` (integer, default `3`): Frames to wait after the action so the UI updates (0..600).

### `sim__ui__find`

List Isaac Sim's own UI widgets (buttons, fields, checkboxes, combo boxes, tree views, and labels when a query is given) with their text, tooltip, current value, a ref, and their centre in pixels of the Isaac Sim window (the same pixels as screenshot(window_id=<Isaac Sim window>)), plus the visible Kit windows. Works while the desktop is locked or used remotely. Use the ref with sim__ui__act instead of guessing coordinates.

- `query` (string, default `""`): Case-insensitive text to match in a widget's name, text, tooltip, identifier or type, e.g. 'play' or 'Add'. Empty lists interactive widgets only.
- `window` (string, default `""`): Only Kit windows whose title contains this text, e.g. 'Stage' or 'Property'.
- `limit` (integer, default `40`): Maximum widgets returned, 1..100 (the reply is also capped near 48 KB).

### `sim__viewport__frame`

Point the active viewport camera, e.g. before a screenshot. path alone frames a prim; path+margin frames its bounds plus margin metres; eye+target places the camera exactly; follow tracks the prim. Edits only the active camera in the session layer, with no undo entry. Refuses look-through targets and empty bounds, listing candidates. Does not wait for rendered pixels. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `path` (string, default `""`): Absolute prim path to frame or follow.
- `margin` (number, optional): Extra radius in metres around the prim's bounding sphere (0..1000), e.g. 1.0 for a small robot that will drive around.
- `eye` (array, optional): Camera position [x, y, z] in world coordinates (stage units).
- `target` (array, optional): Point to look at [x, y, z] in world coordinates (stage units); default: the prim's centre.
- `follow` (boolean, optional): true: follow path while playing (until stopped); false: stop following.

## Assets (`assets__*`)

Reference: [TOOLS-SCENE.md](TOOLS-SCENE.md). 14 tools.

### `assets__dependencies`

Compute USD dependency closures with UsdUtils.ComputeAllDependencies for files under an approved root or a user asset store. Uses a host helper (ISAAC_MCP_USD_PYTHON) or else the selected Kit. Native USD parsing is NOT sandboxed. Copies nothing.

- `paths` (array, required): Absolute USD file paths, 1 to 64.

### `assets__import_path`

Import a trusted local USD by absolute path, under an approved project root or in a pack of the user's asset store. Copies and validates its project dependencies before authoring a reference; source files remain unchanged. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `source_path` (string, required): Absolute local USD path inside an already approved trusted root.
- `prim_path` (string, required): New absolute wrapper prim path; parent must exist.
- `position` (array, default `[0, 0, 0]`): Three finite coordinates in stage units.
- `orientation` (array, default `[1, 0, 0, 0]`): Unit quaternion [w,x,y,z].
- `frame` (string, default `"local"`): Pose frame: local or world.

### `assets__import_urdf`

Convert a trusted approved relative URDF project using the installed importer. Select the shared Physics=physics variant on private generated output when present; refuse missing bodies or expected revolute/prismatic joints before snapshot/import. Returns authored counts, not runtime readiness. No source overwrite. Rejects DTD/entities, package/URL/absolute mesh paths and missing files. Requires 6.x URDFImporter API. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `root_id` (string, required): Approved trusted project root ID.
- `relative_path` (string, required): Relative USD file path within that root.
- `prim_path` (string, required): New wrapper prim path.
- `position` (array, default `[0, 0, 0]`): Three finite coordinates in stage units.
- `orientation` (array, default `[1, 0, 0, 0]`): Unit quaternion [w,x,y,z].
- `frame` (string, default `"local"`): Pose frame: local or world.

### `assets__import_usd`

Import a USER-TRUSTED project snapshot below a new wrapper prim, preserving the source and current stage. Requires stopped timeline, matching units/up-axis, explicit target and no conflict. No URLs or arbitrary asset attributes. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `root_id` (string, required): Approved trusted project root ID.
- `relative_path` (string, required): Relative USD file path within that root.
- `prim_path` (string, required): New absolute wrapper path; parent must exist.
- `position` (array, default `[0, 0, 0]`): Three finite coordinates in stage units.
- `orientation` (array, default `[1, 0, 0, 0]`): Unit quaternion [w,x,y,z].
- `frame` (string, default `"local"`): Pose frame: local or world.

### `assets__info`

Snapshot and inspect a USER-TRUSTED project on the selected Kit. Native USD parsing is NOT sandboxed. Refuses untrusted profiles and unresolved/outside snapshot dependencies. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `root_id` (string, required): Approved trusted project root ID.
- `relative_path` (string, required): Relative USD file path within that root.

### `assets__pack_adopt`

Create a pack in the primary asset folder, or copy a folder's asset files into it and pin them. The source must be under a user-approved root; no tool can approve folders. A different file already there is refused unless force=true; nothing is written inside the repository.

- `pack` (string, required): Pack name: one folder name, no path separators.
- `source_path` (string, optional): Absolute folder under an approved root. Omit to create an empty pack.
- `include` (array, optional): Extra file extensions to copy.
- `files` (array, optional): Copy only these files or folders, relative to source_path. A named file is copied whatever its type.
- `entries` (array, optional): Root USD files, relative to the pack, for assets__pack_doctor. Default: a sole top-level USD.
- `dry_run` (boolean, default `false`): Report the plan and write nothing.
- `force` (boolean, default `false`): Replace files that differ from the source.

### `assets__pack_build`

Copy USD files and only what they depend on into a pack in the primary asset folder, keeping relative layout, and pin them. Sources must be under an approved root or a user asset store; dependencies outside those are never copied. Follows MaterialX and MDL textures too. Unresolved or remote references refuse the build unless allow_unresolved=true, which records them. Files that differ need force=true. Checks the new pack afterwards.

- `pack` (string, required): Destination pack name: one folder name.
- `sources` (array, required): USD files, 1 to 64: absolute paths, or paths inside from_pack. A scene outside from_pack and layout_root is read for its references and not copied.
- `from_pack` (string, optional): Pack that source names and logical references such as robot/ur5e.usd come from.
- `layout_root` (string, optional): Absolute folder the pack layout is relative to. Default: from_pack, or the source's folder.
- `allow_unresolved` (boolean, default `false`): Build despite missing or remote references, and record them.
- `dry_run` (boolean, default `false`): Report the closure and write nothing.
- `force` (boolean, default `false`): Replace files that differ from the source.

### `assets__pack_doctor`

Check a pack without changing it: corrupt, missing and unpinned files, then the USD dependencies of its entry files (unresolved, unreadable, remote, outside the pack). Unused files are information. Parses USD in a host helper (ISAAC_MCP_USD_PYTHON) or else the selected Kit; says so if neither ran, and ok is then false.

- `pack` (string, optional): Pack name. Default: the selected pack.
- `entries` (array, optional): Files in the pack that are its roots. Default: recorded in the pack, or the twin's known names for ur5e-dt.

### `assets__pack_pin`

Record the current SHA-256 of a pack's files in its SHA256SUMS, in the primary asset folder. New files are pinned; a pin that would change accepts whatever bytes are there, so it is refused with before and after hashes unless the file is named in files or force=true.

- `pack` (string, optional): Pack name. Default: the selected pack.
- `files` (array, optional): Pin only these relative paths, accepting their changes.
- `force` (boolean, default `false`): Accept every changed and removed file.

### `assets__packs`

List the asset packs in every store, the selected pack and where that choice came from. Host side, no Kit, no USD parser. Writes nothing.

No arguments.

### `assets__prepare_workstation`

Prepare a trusted project USD and its project files in the UR5e workstation cache without overwriting. Requires an approved root and live Kit dependency validation; call ur5e_dt.load_workstation afterward. Not a sandbox. Requires session_id and stage_id from sim__stage__info.

- `session_id` (string, required): Exact session_id from sim__stage__info (call it first; process incarnation).
- `stage_id` (string, required): Exact stage_id from sim__stage__info (call it first); stale stages are refused.
- `source_path` (string, required): Absolute local USD path inside an already approved trusted root.

### `assets__roots`

List launch-approved project roots and capability refusals. Filename access only; trusted projects are NOT sandboxed.

No arguments.

### `assets__scan`

Bounded filename-only USD discovery on the MCP host. No USD parser. Results are untrusted data.

- `root_id` (string, required): Approved root ID, never an absolute path.
- `offset` (integer, default `0`): Page offset into the sorted bounded scan.
- `limit` (integer, default `50`): Page size 1..100.

### `assets__search`

Fresh filename search across approved project/library roots. No network discovery, semantic service, manifest or fixed robot count. Refresh by calling again.

- `query` (string, default `""`): Case-insensitive filename substring <=128 characters.
- `limit` (integer, default `50`): Maximum results 1..100.

## UR5e twin (`ur5e_dt__*`)

Reference: [TOOLS-UR5E.md](TOOLS-UR5E.md). 23 tools.

### `ur5e_dt__add_objects`

Uses your own lab files from the asset folder, which cannot be downloaded (see docs/ASSETS.md). Add objects to the scene from a predefined assembly folder.

- `assembly` (fmb1|fmb2|fmb3|fmb4|jenga|fmb_jenga, optional): Assembly folder; fmb4 is Jenga, also accepted as jenga or fmb_jenga

### `ur5e_dt__assemble_objects`

Uses your own lab files from the asset folder, which cannot be downloaded (see docs/ASSETS.md). Assemble objects into a specified configuration.

- `assembly` (fmb1|fmb2|fmb3|fmb4|jenga|fmb_jenga, optional): Assembly configuration; fmb4 is Jenga, also accepted as jenga or fmb_jenga

### `ur5e_dt__delete_objects`

Delete all objects from /World/Objects of the UR5e twin and the associated pose publisher graph.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__get_recording_status`

Check if viewport video recording is currently active. Returns status, frame count, elapsed time, output path, and FPS.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__load_simple_room`

Load Isaac's standard Simple Room environment (floor, walls, window, lamp) as a backdrop. Additive (cleared by new_stage): references the standard Isaac Simple_Room asset onto /World/SimpleRoom at z=-0.11 so it matches the source scene under the robot-base-at-0 convention (the Vention bench feet land on the room floor). Hides the default ground plane visual while keeping its z=0 collider, so object/robot physics are unchanged. Does not move the robot. Best used together with load_workstation.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__load_workstation`

Load the Vention bench as visual context under the lab's UR5e twin, at /World/Vention with its top at z=0. Uses your own lab file from the asset folder, which cannot be downloaded (see docs/ASSETS.md); a placeholder bench is used without it. Additive (cleared by new_stage), visual-only and safe while playing. Does not move the robot.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__new_stage`

Clear the entire USD stage and free accumulated memory. Use this when Isaac Sim's process memory has grown large after many scene loads/resets. This tears down all USD prims, Hydra render state, and PhysX allocations. The scene will be empty afterwards — use quick_start to rebuild it.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__play_scene`

Start/resume the simulation timeline. Restores the saved twin's Python ROS callbacks; Newton twin playback uses CPU and needs a stopped stage before first initialization. Does not rebuild saved graphs or switch physics engines.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__quick_start`

RISE lab UR5e digital twin; for a generic start, see sim__quick_start. One-click scene setup from public assets: loads the scene, imports NVIDIA's UR5e with action graphs, creates a workspace camera and starts simulation. Adds the RG2 gripper only when its files are in the asset folder; the result's gripper field says which happened. Uses CPU physics in the selected engine; an existing non-CPU World is refused. Use after new_stage to rebuild a disposable scene.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__quick_start_with_workstation`

RISE lab UR5e digital twin. Uses your own lab files from the asset folder, which cannot be downloaded (see docs/ASSETS.md). A placeholder bench is used without them. Same as quick_start, then loads the Vention workstation bench (see load_workstation). One call builds the full robot+scene and drops the bench underneath. quick_start itself is unchanged.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__quick_start_with_workstation_and_simple_room`

RISE lab UR5e digital twin. Uses your own lab files from the asset folder, which cannot be downloaded (see docs/ASSETS.md). A placeholder bench is used without them. Same as quick_start, then loads the Vention workstation bench AND the Simple Room backdrop. One call builds the full robot+scene, the bench under the robot, and the room around it. quick_start itself is unchanged.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__randomize_object_poses`

Randomize the positions of non-base objects in /World/Objects of the UR5e twin, after ur5e_dt__add_objects.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__randomize_single_object`

Randomize the position of a single named object in a clear workspace area, keeping all other objects fixed.

- `object_name` (string, optional): Name of the object to randomize (e.g. 'inverted_u_yellow')

### `ur5e_dt__restore_scene_state`

Restore the UR5e twin's object poses from a JSON file made by ur5e_dt__save_scene_state. Returns result and, on failure, error.

- `json_file_path` (string, optional): Path to restore from. If omitted, the most recent save is used.

### `ur5e_dt__save_scene_state`

Save the UR5e twin's object poses to a JSON file in its scene_states folder, for ur5e_dt__restore_scene_state. A file of that name is replaced; with no name it gets a timestamp. Returns result, file_path and, on failure, error.

- `json_file_path` (string, optional): Path to save file. If omitted, a timestamped filename is used.

### `ur5e_dt__set_object_pose`

Teleport a scene object under /World/Objects to an EXACT world pose. Use to set up controlled scenes — e.g. placing two parts close together to exercise neighbour-aware grasp gating. Applies via the same xformOp path randomize uses, so it persists under physics (object stays put on play). Mirror it with setup_pose_publisher so /objects_poses_sim reflects the new pose.

- `object_name` (string, optional): Object name under /World/Objects (e.g. 'u_brown').
- `position` (array, optional): [x, y, z] world position in METERS.
- `orientation` (array, optional): Optional [w, x, y, z] quaternion. If given, overrides yaw_deg.
- `yaw_deg` (number, optional): Optional yaw rotation about world z in degrees (used when orientation is omitted). Default 0 (identity).

### `ur5e_dt__setup_camera_tf_graph`

Import the RealSense camera, attach it to the UR5e wrist and build its ROS 2 action graph (camera image, camera_info and the /tf_cam transform tree). Requires the UR5e to be loaded (e.g. after quick_start_with_workstation).

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__setup_pose_publisher`

Create an action graph publishing the UR5e twin's object poses to ROS 2 topic objects_poses_sim, after ur5e_dt__add_objects.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__start_recording`

Start real-time viewport video recording using ffmpeg. Records frames from the viewport render buffer without blocking physics. Returns immediately — call stop_recording to finalize the video.

- `file_name` (string, optional): Output filename (e.g. 'my_recording.mp4'). Saved to the configured VIDEOS_DIR. Defaults to 'realtime_recording.mp4'.
- `camera` (string, optional): Camera prim path to record from (e.g. '/World/workspace_camera_sim'). If omitted, uses the active viewport camera.
- `fps` (integer, optional): Frames per second for the output video. Defaults to 30.

### `ur5e_dt__start_ros_driver`

Bring the ROS 2 driver of the lab's UR5e twin up, down or report status, so robot-motion tools have a driver. backend='fake' (default) is sim only, with mock hardware and no Docker, ready in seconds; 'ursim' needs Docker and is the path to mode='real' (not yet enabled). Refuses if another UR driver is detected. Stop the fake driver before stopping its simulator. Managed sim__launch sessions support only fake. Use once at startup.

- `mode` (sim|real, optional): 'sim' (default) or 'real' (lab UR5e — not yet enabled; requires backend='ursim').
- `action` (up|down|status, optional): 'up' (default) brings the driver up, 'down' tears it down, 'status' reports state.
- `backend` (fake|ursim, optional): 'fake' (default) = apt ur_robot_driver fake hardware via launch_ur_fake.sh (lightweight, sim only); 'ursim' = URSim docker via sim_bringup.sh (needs Docker + ~/ros2_ws; required for mode='real'; unavailable in managed sessions).

### `ur5e_dt__stop_recording`

Stop the current real-time viewport recording and finalize the MP4 video file. Returns the output file path and frame count.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__stop_scene`

Stop the UR5e twin's simulation timeline, e.g. before generic sim__* edits. Stop rewinds physics to the authored start pose. For other scenes use sim__timeline__control.

No arguments.

### `ur5e_dt__sync_real_poses`

Wait up to 3 seconds for /objects_poses_real and update matching sim objects. Reports an error if no message or matching objects arrive, and lists updated and snapped objects.

No arguments.
